## Pull request checklist

- [ ] Task/issue: `AUTH-01` / `USER-01` / other
- [ ] Scope is limited to the assigned module or task
- [ ] No permanent Teacher/Student/Mentor participant role was introduced
- [ ] No fake product data or fake provider success was added
- [ ] Tests were added or updated
- [ ] Lint and typecheck pass
- [ ] Database migrations, if any, are reviewed and backward-compatible
- [ ] API/event contracts and documentation were updated if needed
- [ ] Accessibility and security implications were considered
- [ ] No secrets or local environment files are included
